intro.text: A skaa thief and crew leader in Luthadel.

items.text: Learned that the Steel Ministry quietly moved large sums to Luthadel with acolytes heading there for final training, and spent five years and thousands of boxings setting up a theft. He faked lost contracts to make House Jedue look desperate, so a cut-price bid to run the Ministry's canal boats seemed natural.

Needing someone to play Lord Jedue, he reluctantly partnered with Camon. Knowing Theron's money was stretched thin, Camon took the three-thousand-boxing down payment and walked away, leaving Theron to face the Ministry's anger.
Vin remembered that he had a bribable obligator contact on the acolytes' canal route, so Dockson used that contact to get Marsh into the Steel Ministry as an acolyte.
The Steel Inquisitors hunting Vin traced her link to his crew and slaughtered all of them.

appearance.text: A tall man in a plain grey shirt and slacks, with a thin sword tied at his waist.

personality.text: Leered at Vin so openly that she nearly used her Luck on him to make him stop.
